tools.name: scan_domain
tools.description: Run a free email-deliverability scan (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, DNS blocklists) for a domain and return a 0-100 score with per-check findings. Anonymous, no account required, rate-limited to 5 scans/hour per IP.

domain.description: Domain to scan, e.g. example.com (apex domain, no scheme or path).
